announcement.ts.why: Consumer publishes the prose; the word 'announcement' is not a decision signal.

ban-account.ts.why: Destructive action and a written policy that requires a moderator decision.

classify-and-reply.ts.why: Composite: stored category is a decision; the sent reply stays generation.

consolidation.ts.why: Three bounded decisions over the same ticket; one request with parallel questions.

customer-response.ts.why: Consumer returns the prose to the user.

eligibility-noul.ts.why: Consumer uses only a boolean condition.

email-validation.ts.why: Email syntax is settled by an exact rule; no model or JEV needed.

embedding-rerank.ts.why: Retrieval stays in the vector index; the re-rank call is a per-item Score candidate.

high-risk-refund.ts.why: Bounded approve/deny condition on a money path; shadow-only until a human sets the action policy.

http-ok.ts.why: Plain fetch and status check; no model call.

opaque-forward.ts.why: Prompt is caller-supplied and the consumer is external; output shape cannot be established.

prompt-constant.ts.why: Prompt constant defined in another file lists a closed set; consumer uses only the route.

prompt-text.ts.why: A prompt string is not a call-site; it is read as context for prompt-constant.ts.

regex-intent.ts.why: Regex doing semantic intent work; reported only with --wide, never as a candidate.

ticket-router.ts.why: Consumer dispatches only the selected queue.

urgency-score.ts.why: Consumer uses only an ordered 1-5 level.
